rules.text: All signalling questions are phrased so that yes or probably yes indicates low risk of bias.
Any no or probably no flags the potential for bias; assessors use judgement to rate the whole domain.
No information is used only when reported information is insufficient to permit a judgement.
Not applicable may be available for items not applicable to certain model types or situations.

standard.source: Moons et al, BMJ 2025;388:e082505, Table 2 footnote (p. 8) and p. 10

official_statements.text: For model evaluation, each domain is judged as low, high or unclear risk of bias, based on the signalling question answers and assessor judgement.
A no answer does not automatically result in a high risk of bias rating for the entire domain.
Step 4 combines the four domain ratings into an overall judgement (low, high or unclear). The detailed guidance is in supplementary table 3, which has not been extracted.

modelaudit_decisions.text: The system never proposes or computes a domain risk-of-bias judgement. It only summarises the answers and flags questions answered no or probably no for attention.

Because only a subset of each domain's questions is assessed (see domains.coverage), any domain judgement a reviewer records must be labelled as based on a subset and is not an official PROBAST+AI domain rating.
No overall (Step 4) risk-of-bias judgement and no numeric score are produced in the MVP.

official.definition: Concern that the participants and setting, the predictors, or the outcome do not match the review question or the assessor's intended use of the model.
official.requires: A specified review question or intended use, defined with PICOTS in Step 1.
official.source: Moons et al, BMJ 2025;388:e082505, pp. 10-11 and Table 2, p. 8

modelaudit_decisions.text: Applicability stays not assessed unless the reviewer supplies the intended use or PICOTS. The transportability layer is deferred, so no automatic comparison is made.
Applicability judgements are never merged with risk-of-bias judgements, and are stored in a separate structure.

step2_classification.source: Moons et al, BMJ 2025;388:e082505, p. 10 (Step 2) and Box 1, pp. 3-4
official_notes: A separate assessment is done for each model and, as relevant, for each of the apparent, internal and external evaluation components (p. 9, p. 11).
For studies that only develop models, both parts of PROBAST+AI must usually still be completed (p. 11). The MVP assesses the evaluation part only.

modelaudit_global_rules: Use only the supplied excerpts. Every answer other than no_information needs at least one verbatim quotation with chunk_id and PDF page.
no_information and not_assessed are different. not_assessed means the system did not run the question. no_information is an official answer meaning the paper gave too little to judge.
A quotation that exists in the paper does not by itself show that it supports the answer.
Never state or imply that a model is clinically valid, safe or ready for use.
Do not use TRIPOD+AI reporting categories. PROBAST+AI answers use the official response scale only.
